scope: Local runtime provenance, structural comparison of two Webgo XLSX references, operational-memory consolidation
authority: Same branch; local diagnostics/restart and graph/roadmap organization only. No Ads calls, credential resolution, official DB changes, workbook modification or execution of embedded content.

data_lifecycle.encryption: No new credential storage; filesystem encryption not attested

score_reason: Capability comparison, not account performance or platform-health audit
